about.title: About RAVEN
about.lead: A sneaker shop in Erbil, run by people who actually wear the shoes.
about.storyBody: RAVEN started in 2019 as a single wall of sneakers and a promise: nothing fake, ever. We grew because people kept sending their friends. That's still the whole business model.
about.storyBody2: Today we carry Hoka, Nike, Jordan, adidas and Skechers across sizes 36 to 48, for running, walking, ball and everyday wear. If we don't have your size on the wall, we'll tell you straight instead of selling you the wrong fit.
about.v1Body: We buy through authorised channels and check every pair. No replicas, no excuses.
about.v2Body: Some models run small. We'll say so, even when it costs us the sale.
about.v3Body: If it's on the site, it's on the shelf. We update stock the same day.
about.v4Body: Seven days to exchange an unworn pair, box and receipt in hand.
about.ctaLead: Message us — someone in the store answers, not a bot.
